title: FDIC insurance when a bank fails
facts: FDIC deposit insurance is automatic for eligible deposits at an FDIC-insured bank; depositors do not separately purchase FDIC insurance.
When an insured bank fails, the FDIC generally works to provide insured depositors access to insured funds promptly, often by transferring deposits to another insured institution or issuing payment.
Amounts above applicable insurance limits may become claims against the failed bank's receivership rather than insured deposits.
